# Why Should I Trust You: Explaining the Predictions of Any Classifier

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Marco Tulio Ribeiro, Sameer Singh, Carlos Guestrin  
**Year:** 2017  
**Journal:** KDD  
**DOI:** [10.1145/2939672.2939778](https://doi.org/10.1145/2939672.2939778)  
**Publisher:** [https://arxiv.org/abs/1602.04938](https://arxiv.org/abs/1602.04938)

**Keywords:** lime, interpretability

## Abstract

We propose LIME a novel explanation technique that explains the predictions of any classifier in an interpretable and faithful manner.
